def move(terrain, start, duration_s, n_runs, seed):
    import numpy as np
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)

    N_STEPS = 60
    dt = duration_s / (N_STEPS - 1)
    lat0, lon0 = start

    # Initialize output arrays
    points = np.empty((n_runs, N_STEPS, 3), dtype=np.float64)
    points[:, 0, 0] = lat0
    points[:, 0, 1] = lon0
    points[:, 0, 2] = 0

    # Direction fixed northeast ~ 45 degrees (clockwise from north)
    # Add small random angular noise with std ~ 10 degrees (0.1745 rad)
    base_bearing = np.deg2rad(45)
    bearing_noise = rng.normal(0, 0.1745, n_runs)  # rad
    bearings = base_bearing + bearing_noise  # shape (n_runs,)

    # Convert start lat/lon tometers-scale ratios for displacement approximation
    m_per_deg_lat = terrain.m_lat
    m_per_deg_lon = terrain.m_lon

    # Initialize current lat, lon
    lat = np.full(n_runs, lat0)
    lon = np.full(n_runs, lon0)

    # Precompute distance per step target distribution to fit published stats:
    # Median ~ 2.86 km at duration_s sec -> average speed ~ 2.86 km / duration_s m/s
    # Let's target median walking speed ~ 1.3 m/s along ridge, slower on steeper slopes.
    # Allow walkers speed ~0.7 to 2.0 m/s with noise.
    # Pace variation sampled once per run:
    base_speed_mps = rng.uniform(0.7, 2.0, n_runs)  # m/s forward pace
    # Add small random rest probability: per step rest with 15% chance to pause 0-3 sec (uniform)
    rest_chance = 0.15
    rest_max_s = 3

    times = np.zeros(n_runs)
    step_s = dt
    for i in range(1, N_STEPS):
        # Current slope at all walkers
        elev = terrain.elev(lat, lon)
        slope_deg = terrain.slope_deg(lat, lon)

        # Filter out extremely steep slopes > 30 deg by slowing down speed:
        slope_factor = np.clip(1 - (slope_deg / 30) * 0.7, 0.3, 1.0)
        # Encourage movement along less steep patches northeast along ridge:
        # but do not stagnate on zero slope, min speed factor = 0.3
        speed_mps = base_speed_mps * slope_factor

        # Random small rest event adds pause time and zero distance this step
        rest_events = rng.random(n_runs) < rest_chance
        rest_durations = rng.uniform(0, rest_max_s, n_runs) * rest_events

        # Effective step duration reduced by rest durations, min step_s*0.25
        effective_dt = np.maximum(step_s - rest_durations, step_s*0.25)

        # Distance traveled
        dist_m = speed_mps * effective_dt

        # Move position along bearing
        lat, lon = terrain.offset(lat, lon, bearings, dist_m)

        # Clamp location to terrain box; mark out of box below
        lat, lon = terrain.clamp(lat, lon)

        times += step_s  # time always increments by step_s for recording
        points[:, i, 0] = lat
        points[:, i, 1] = lon
        points[:, i, 2] = times

    # Check which runs remain inside box at all times (last position)
    ok = terrain.inside(points[:, -1, 0], points[:, -1, 1])
    return points, ok
